name: ShortcutRail
description: Responsive YAMI shortcut navigation rail with circular image icons, localized labels, native scrolling, overflow-aware paging controls, optional card or plain section surfaces, and an optional left-aligned titled gray treatment.

figma.notes: Implemented from the YAMI homepage PC shortcut rail reference supplied through browser annotation.

items.description: Ordered shortcut destinations with stable IDs, labels, icon sources, hrefs, and an optional icon or full-bleed image presentation.

surface.description: Section surface. Card uses the shared homepage inset, surface radius, compact padding, and primary background without a border or shadow; plain spans the available width.

title.description: Optional visible section title. When present, the rail uses the left-aligned gray-surface treatment and the title labels the navigation region.

dividerPosition.description: Optional full-width divider edge for the plain surface. Card separation comes from spacing and radius.

dividerVariant.description: Divider color and width treatment: gray is 1px and black is 2px emphasis.

ariaLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the navigation region.

previousLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the previous-page control.

lines.description: Rows the mobile rail flows into below 1024px (Figma 3183:34141). Two rows page horizontally as one block, keeping a long list a single swipe deep. PC always renders a single row. Entry width is pinned to the Figma 68px in both, with a four-entry floor, so the viewport decides how many are visible rather than the entry stretching.

nextLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the next-page control.

tapTarget.note: Shortcut links include the 80px icon surface; paging controls compose the shared YAMI RailNavigation button.

focus.note: Every shortcut link and paging control remains keyboard reachable with a token-backed focus ring.

radius.note: Card surfaces use --radius-surface-default, icon surfaces use --radius-full, and links use --radius-component-default.

gradient.note: The white-to-transparent edge mask is a functional overflow affordance matching the existing Header category rail.

accessibility.role: labelled navigation containing a list of shortcut links
accessibility.ariaPattern: nav with list/listitem links, optional visible title, and optional previous/next buttons
accessibility.structure: A supplied title labels the navigation region; otherwise ariaLabel is used. Visible labels provide link names and decorative icon images use empty alt text.
accessibility.interaction: Mobile uses native horizontal scrolling without paging chrome. Desktop adds overflow-aware paging controls over functional edge masks.
